tvShows.name: Indian Game Show
tvShows.description: Indian Game Show with Bharti and Harssh is a lively entertainment game show hosted by the popular duo. Celebrities take on fun physical, comedy and skill-based challenges, competing for exciting prizes while facing amusing punishments. With audience participation, engaging interactions and Harssh-Bharti's signature humour, each episode delivers laughter, surprises and family entertainment.
